correspondence.subject: Application - Tagalog Congregation Ashburton
correspondence.summary: Daniel confirmed receipt of the S-51 and requested S-29, S-5, M-202, S-36 and S-6. He also asked for the body’s recommendation(s) for the prospective coordinator as soon as possible.
correspondence.action: Completed — the requested S-50 par. 5 package was sent to Daniel at 10:03 p.m. on 30 August 2026 with all seven files and independently verified in Sent Items.
correspondence.body:
Dear Brothers,

Thank you for submitting the S-51 form.

Can you please now submit the following documents as mentioned in paragraph 5 of the Instructions for Recommending New Congregations (S-50):

• Coordinator of the Body of Elders/Secretary Change of Address (S-29)
• Kingdom Hall Information (S-5)
• Periodical Request (M-202)
• Shipping Information (S-36)
• Territory Adjustment Request (S-6)

Once you have completed these forms, please send them to me.

As a side note, please forward the body’s recommendation(s) for COBE as soon as possible, as I will need to appoint a coordinator for the new congregation if it is approved. SFG 1:11, 12

Thank you for your hard work, brothers.

Warm regards,
Daniel Martin
Circuit NZ-1
